models.name: YOLOv8n — Primary Aerial Dataset
models.description: Fine-tuned YOLOv8n detector used by the desktop app for live inference. Trained 100 epochs, AdamW, imgsz 640, batch 16 on RTX 4050.

models.name: YOLOv8n-cls — Leaf Classifier (Two-Stage)
models.description: Full-frame / per-box classifier that refines detector labels when AGRIVISION_INFER_MODE=both. Distinguishes Black Sigatoka, Bunchy Top, Panama, Moko, Yellow Sigatoka, Healthy, Not-Banana.

models.name: YOLOv8n — Primary + Secondary Datasets
models.dataset: Primary aerial set supplemented with public banana-disease datasets (see docs/SECONDARY_DATASETS.md)
models.description: Retraining run that supplements the imbalanced primary dataset with secondary sources to lift rare-class recall (panama, bunchy_top). Metrics populate automatically once its results.csv path is configured here.

benchmark.protocol: All contenders fine-tuned on the same datasets/yolo_banana split (593 train / 33 val / 34 test) for 100 epochs at imgsz 640, then scored on the held-out test split with identical inference settings.

contenders.name: YOLOv8n
contenders.notes: Same architecture the desktop app deploys. Retrained under the shared benchmark recipe so the comparison is apples-to-apples.

contenders.name: YOLOv9t
contenders.notes: The size-matched YOLOv9: 2.0M params and 7.9 GFLOPs against YOLOv8n's 3.0M and 8.2 GFLOPs. Because it is slightly smaller at equal compute, beating YOLOv8n here is evidence about the architecture rather than about capacity.

contenders.name: YOLOv9s
contenders.notes: GELAN backbone with programmable gradient information. At 2.4x YOLOv8n's parameters it is not a like-for-like comparison; treat its win as the expected result of a bigger model.

contenders.name: YOLO-NAS S
contenders.notes: Neural-architecture-searched detector from Deci. Ultralytics ships no trainer for it, so it is fine-tuned and scored in the separate venv-nas environment via tools/train_yolo_nas.py.
